limitations: 14 November cancellation counts are time-bound operational observations, not final financial or GDP loss.
US-China tariff measures remain under negotiation, with no ratified cuts treated as completed.
Japanese bond/currency data refer to 12 November and Friday equities/yields to 13 November.
No verified total for affected Brazil-US travelers or global private credit spreads.
contrary_evidence: Positive US weekly equity returns coexist with negative Friday cash-market closes.
Open US airspace does not imply that displaced airline networks have returned to normal.
A negotiated tariff figure does not prove enacted concessions or realized imports.
Producer-price inflation and sovereign yields do not map one for one onto CPI or corporate borrowing rates.
